# starcreates

> starcreates is an independent Roblox game studio founded by inf and esyt. It builds community-first Roblox games, including Build or Die and +1 ASMR Keyboard Destruction, and partners with, invests in and acquires Roblox games from other developers.

## Key facts

- Website: https://starcreates.org
- Platform: Roblox
- Founders: inf (@infirmn), Co-Founder & Lead Developer, 7+ years experience; esyt (@ESGaminggg), Co-Founder & Community Lead
- Over 2 million play sessions across all starcreates games
- More than 342,000 players and around 24,500 monthly active users
- Contact: hello@starcreates.org, @starcreates_dev on X
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/starcreates/

## Games

- Build or Die: 2M+ visits, 25,900+ favourites, 84,300+ likes, peak of 724 concurrent players
- [+1 ASMR Keyboard Destruction](https://www.roblox.com/games/87361386694346): 59,800+ visits, 2,300+ favourites, peak of 378 concurrent players
- A new, larger project is in development

## Pages

- [Home](https://starcreates.org/): about the studio, stats, founders, FAQ and contact
- [Games](https://starcreates.org/games): every starcreates Roblox game with visit and favourite counts
